patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Vonage and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Vonage only if your buying job matches “SMB/mid VoIP business phone (VBC) — Mobile from $13.99/line/mo on 12-month promo; Premium/” rather than Zoom's shape. Choose Zoom only if your buying job matches “Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floo” rather than Vonage's shape. Workflow advantage: Vonage leans sales-calling; Zoom leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Vonage and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Vonage is SMB/mid VoIP business phone (VBC) — Mobile from $13.99/line/mo on 12-month promo; Premium/Advanced higher.; Zoom is Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floor ~$15–16/user/month; free meetings/chat exist but.
- Company-size focus: Vonage (solo, small-business, mid-market) vs Zoom (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Vonage-leaning sales-calling vs Zoom-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Vonage — Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors; Zoom — Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service.

Limitations — Vonage: Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors; Call recording and deeper CRM land on Advanced / Premium packaging; Zoom: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service; Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive.

Poor-fit cases: Vonage is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Taxes and regulatory fees sit on top of published per-line floors · Zoom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service · Avoid Vonage if you actually need Zoom's motion (Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited res)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
